topic: Methods of applying surface protection, preparation of paints, equipment used, common paint and troubles
syllabus_extract: Methods of applying surface protection, preparation of paints, equipment used, common paint and troubles.
specific_objectives: 6.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand surface protection materials, paint identification, restoration of various paint and application, dope shop, dope articles and troubles.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of paint preparation and application techniques using standard equipment; Safety precautions include PPE usage and ventilation; Instructor supervision required for all mixing and spraying activities.
intro_questions: What are the primary functions of surface protection materials?
List three common types of paints used in aircraft maintenance.
Why is surface preparation critical before applying paint?

development.content:
Surface protection materials overview
Paint identification and coding
Restoration of existing paint systems
Standard application methods
Dope shop operations and articles

Paint preparation procedures
Equipment usage and maintenance
Common paint troubles and defects
Troubleshooting application issues
Safety protocols during application

Review of paint identification codes
Analysis of common paint defects
Corrective actions for application errors
Proper storage of paint materials
Final inspection criteria

summary_questions: Explain the correct procedure for preparing a paint mixture for application.
Identify two common paint defects and their likely causes.
Describe the key safety measures required when operating paint equipment.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the differences between dope articles and standard paints, referencing the next lesson plan on colors and marking on naval aircraft.

pft_rows.syllabus: Colors and marking on naval aircraft.
